# app/controllers/api/v1/auth_controller.rb
require 'jwt'
require 'openssl'

module Api
  module V1
    class AuthController < ApplicationController
      skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
      before_action :authenticate_request, except: [:login]

      HMAC_SECRET = ENV['JWT_HMAC_SECRET'] || 'fallback_dev_secret_32bytes!!'
      RSA_PUBLIC_KEY = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(ENV.fetch('RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH', '/app/config/keys/public.pem')))

      def login
        user = User.find_by(email: params[:email])
        if user&.authenticate(params[:password])
          token = JWT.encode(
            { user_id: user.id, role: user.role, exp: 24.hours.from_now.to_i },
            OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(ENV.fetch('RSA_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH', '/app/config/keys/private.pem'))),
            'RS256'
          )
          render json: { token: token }, status: :ok
        else
          render json: { error: 'Invalid credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end

      def protected_resource
        render json: { data: 'sensitive_payload', user: @current_user.as_json(except: [:password_digest]) }
      end

      def admin_action
        unless @current_user.role == 'admin'
          return render json: { error: 'Forbidden' }, status: :forbidden
        end
        render json: { users: User.all.as_json(except: [:password_digest]) }
      end

      private

      def authenticate_request
        header = request.headers['Authorization']
        token = header&.split(' ')&.last

        return render json: { error: 'Token missing' }, status: :unauthorized unless token

        begin
          # Decode token - accepts algorithm specified in token header
          # This supports both legacy HMAC tokens and new RSA tokens
          decoded = JWT.decode(token, nil, true, {
            algorithms: ['RS256', 'HS256'],
            verify_expiration: true
          }) do |header, payload|
            # Key resolver: pick key based on declared algorithm
            case header['alg']
            when 'RS256'
              RSA_PUBLIC_KEY
            when 'HS256'
              HMAC_SECRET
            else
              raise JWT::DecodeError, 'Unsupported algorithm'
            end
          end

          @current_user = User.find(decoded[0]['user_id'])
        rescue JWT::ExpiredSignature
          render json: { error: 'Token expired' }, status: :unauthorized
        rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
          Rails.logger.warn("JWT decode failure: #{e.message} from #{request.remote_ip}")
          render json: { error: 'Invalid token' }, status: :unauthorized
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
          render json: { error: 'User not found' }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
